name: Image-Conditioned Diffusion Fine-Tuning
definition: A fine-tuning stage where a Diffusion Model learns high-level scene content from adjacent reference images without pose information, to identify 'what exists within the scene'.
summary: Image-Conditioned Diffusion Fine-Tuning is a training stage that learns semantic content from adjacent reference images without camera pose information, isolating semantic understanding to handle complex occlusions.
